evidence_class: MEASUREMENT (registry geometry + gate correction); no new score, no holdout, no organizer receipt
method_paragraph: Re-measured the candidate and three alternatives against all real sibling submissions in the registry using the shared 3-px kernel (gemsw.exact.kernel_credit_field, RADIUS_PX=3.0) through scripts/check_uniqueness.py (candidate path now an argument; rows classified submission vs input_feature). Directed overlap = share of candidate dots within 3 px of any comparator dot; rank correlation = Spearman. Also measured the union coverage of all submissions (scripts/uniqueness_coverage.py).
hypothesis: The candidate passes the user's literal uniqueness rule (<=0.70 directed 3-px overlap vs any registry raster).
result: REFUTED for all four candidates; the binding comparator is the 13GEMSDOE r13 lattice (0.9895-0.9996).
wall_clock_budget_note: Three experiments or two hours maximum: 0 design experiments; 4 full-registry audits plus 1 coverage pass.
verdict: negative for the literal rule, confirmed on every candidate in the repo: no file is cleared; additional independent failure vs the 13GEMSDOE r13 lattice (0.9895-0.9996)
governing_decision_source: docs/data/release_gate.json on main (fail-closed literal dense-witness stop); this branch does not change it
estimates_labels: No estimate or score is produced here. The 0.47 (invdesign) and 0.275 (KHD) figures are ESTIMATE-labelled model outputs carried from earlier evidence; none is HOLDOUT-DTI or ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED.
